dataset_title: Vinamilk OCR 2011 Vietnamese Scan Diagnostic v1
source: Signed Vietnamese consolidated financial statement page from a third-party preview of Vinamilk's 2011 audited statements; key figures cross-checked against the issuer's official 2011 annual report.
reference_method: Manual visual transcription of the scanned page; financial labels and figures checked against the official born-digital Vinamilk annual report.
limitations: Single page from a third-party preview, not an issuer-hosted scan asset. Diagnostic only: it does not represent a broad Vietnamese scan sample, has no reviewed cell coordinates, and must not be pooled into the v7 paired benchmark or used for OCR model selection.
